== Name

index-order - index occurrence ordering

== Synopsis

*index-order*

== Description

[[target]]
C00 ((Shared)) prose before.

[source,rust,subs="+macros,+quotes,+replacements"]
----
C01 ((Shared)) root before.
C02 https://example.org[Linked ((Shared))] nested middle.
C03 ((Shared)) root after.
C04 *Bold ((Shared))* formatted label.
C05 (((Hidden))) concealed root.
C06 mailto:user@example.org[Mail ((Shared))] email label.
C07 ((Shared)) after email.
C08 xref:target[Target ((Shared))] cross-reference label.
C09 ((Shared)) after cross-reference.
C10 footnote:note[One note.] before ((Shared)).
C11 https://example.org[Two-line
label ((Shared))] then ((Shared)).
C12 ((Shared)) final line.
----

[source,rust,linenums,start=7,highlight="8",subs="+macros"]
----
C13 ((Shared)) numbered root.
C14 https://example.org[Numbered ((Shared))] nested label.
C15 ((Shared)) after numbered label.
----

[source,rust,subs="+macros"]
----
(((Hidden)))
----

[source,rust,subs="none"]
----
C16 ((Disabled)) https://example.org[((Disabled))]
----
